# mistershell_recording_rule (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell recording_rule by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_recording_rule" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_recording_rule" "by_name" {
  name = "recording-rule"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `name` (String) Name.
